notes:
FINDING: All standing committees held meetings during the period under review.
RECOMMENDATION: Management should continue to ensure that committee meetings are effectively conducted and that all resolutions are implemented to strengthen governance and accountability.
ACTION TAKEN: Management has developed annual meeting calendars, instructed secretaries to maintain accurate minutes, and introduced action trackers to monitor implementation of resolutions.

FINDING: Total revenue collection stood at 82%, while total expenditure reached 84% of the approved budget. This reflects expenditure running slightly ahead of revenue collection, posing a risk of overruns.
RECOMMENDATION: Expenditure should be closely aligned to actual revenue inflows, and budget performance should be reviewed regularly to avoid cash flow challenges.
ACTION TAKEN: Management has instituted monthly budget reviews and adopted a cash flow management framework to match commitments with collections.

FINDING: Own source revenue collection stood at 78% of the budget, indicating underperformance due to low compliance in property rates and market levels.
RECOMMENDATION: Revenue mobilization should be enhanced through enforcement, automation, and broadening the revenue base.
ACTION TAKEN: Management has updated the valuation roll, intensified debt recovery, and introduced electronic payment platforms to improve compliance.

FINDING: Segregation of duties was weak and bank reconciliations were delayed, increasing the risk of errors.
RECOMMENDATION: Strengthen segregation of duties and ensure reconciliations are performed and reviewed promptly.
ACTION TAKEN: Additional staff were assigned to accounts, reconciliations are now conducted monthly, and reviews are performed by senior officers.

FINDING: Stock records were in place and consistently maintained, with access restricted to authorized personnel.
RECOMMENDATION: Continue proper management of stores through regular stock verification and adherence to authorization procedures for issuing consumables.
ACTION TAKEN: Monthly stock verifications are conducted, and stores access remains restricted to authorized personnel only.

FINDING: All procurement activities fully complied with procurement regulations; however, some documentation was incomplete.
RECOMMENDATION: Ensure strict adherence to the Public Procurement Act and maintain complete procurement records.
ACTION TAKEN: Staff have undergone training in procurement compliance, and all procurement requests are now processed through the Electronic Government Procurement (EGPC) system.

FINDING: Payroll processes were up to date, and employee personal files were complete.
RECOMMENDATION: Continue to ensure timely updates to payroll and maintain full employee records.
ACTION TAKEN: The payroll has been cleaned, personal files updated, and quarterly payroll reviews introduced.

FINDING: A risk register was in place; however, monitoring of mitigation strategies was limited.
RECOMMENDATION: Continue maintaining the risk register and strengthen mechanisms to monitor risks regularly.
ACTION TAKEN: Management has implemented a risk management framework, and departmental heads have been tasked with quarterly risk reporting.
